ordinal_dispositions.summary: Idle cognition crashed whenever optional torch-backed subconscious import was unavailable; inline deterministic fallback restored basic capability. Optional learned dependency failure must not erase the enclosing capability.

Entity architecture was replaced by solo room sessions/art generation across scheduler, spatial state, immune/lifecycle, memory exclusions and prompt ontology. Cross-surface migrations must be atomic/versioned; narrative room metaphors are derived projections, not semantic authority.

Micro-LLM fallback failed from 4096-context overflow until grounded preamble was stripped, input/output capped and condensed system prompt used only on fallback. Backend fallback requires an explicit context-projection contract and cannot silently reuse an incompatible primary prompt envelope.

Updater added model/binary registry, size checks, service/health checks, inference probes and auto-repair. Artifact existence alone is weaker than runnable semantic readiness; model/runtime identity should be verified by layered health evidence.

Added Ollama as last-resort chat fallback and changed UI health to any backend available. Availability fallback improves liveness but heterogeneous backends are not semantically interchangeable; provider/model provenance must survive routing.

Central rotating file logging was added across 28 services for persistent diagnosis. Cross-service observability is prerequisite evidence for causal recovery, but duplicate handlers/log schema drift require service/version provenance.

WebUI/metrics generalized from AMD to NVIDIA/Intel and overlay gained durable crash logs; updater service map was corrected. Hardware-specific probes need capability adapters and missing telemetry must be explicit rather than interpreted as zero/healthy.

Idle-thought stagnation traced to repetitive openers, AURA queue flood/backlog and prompt distribution; queue gained hard cap, TTL purge, slower consumption and prompt rebalance. Unbounded derived-event queues can become self-reinforcing causal inputs and need backpressure/staleness semantics.

Installer appeared frozen because needrestart interactive prompts plus silenced apt output blocked progress. Fix added noninteractive environment, visible stage output and tolerant failures. Long effects need phase/deadline receipts and visible failure state; silence is not quiescence.

Room/body/activity data existed in source state but slim projection and 80-char budget prevented it from reaching chat; expanding projection restored behavioral availability. Stored/authoritative state is distinct from model-facing projection and projection budget can create false functional absence.

Entity session rows misclassified as non-system polluted recent/FTS chat context; 66 existing rows required repair and filters were added. Memory admission/classification errors propagate through retrieval; exclusion policy must be typed at write time and query time, with migration receipts.
Rebuilt packaged installer to carry prior Ollama safeguards; binary packaging event inherits source semantics and receives no separate mechanism credit.

All chat was switched to Qwen because DeepSeek-R1 reportedly overrode Frank persona/system identity. Model/backend choice is behaviorally causal; adapter equivalence must be measured on frozen production-context tasks rather than assumed from capability class.

Ollama install made fail-soft/idempotent and streaming chat restored notify_chat_start because that ingress bypassed core. User-priority arbitration must cover every ingress path, not only one central handler.

Reverted prior Ollama removal and chat-start notification, simultaneously reintroducing dependency and arbitration behavior. Reverts are first-class provenance events and must not be treated as monotonic architecture evolution.

Removed Ollama from installer in favor of built-in adaptive vision and added chat-start arbitration on streaming path; immediately reverted by k190 then later reintroduced in safer form. Demonstrates need for executable capability-graph migration and rollback tests.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Torch import failure killed all idle thoughts until deterministic constants were available as fallback.
distilled_invariants.validation: Lesion optional learned module/dependency; enclosing capability remains alive with explicit degraded-mode receipt and deterministic fallback.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Primary prompt/context overflowed the smaller fallback model; later heterogeneous model switches changed persona behavior.
distilled_invariants.validation: Each backend declares context budget/projection, model identity and expected semantic tier; fallback differential tests compare required decisions/identity/tool behavior and mark degradation rather than claim equivalence.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Updater progressed from artifact checks to service health and inference probes while UI sometimes treated any available model as equivalent LLM health.
distilled_invariants.validation: Capability readiness ladder distinguishes artifact present, process active, endpoint healthy, dependency healthy and task/semantic probe PASS; UI reports provider/degraded tier.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: AURA reflection queue backlog and repetitive prompts reinforced stagnation until hard caps, purge and cooldown were introduced.
distilled_invariants.validation: Flood/replay test cannot grow queue unbounded; stale derived events expire/quarantine; dropping/expiry is receipted and does not rewrite source evidence.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Room/body data existed yet 80-char/slim projection made it unavailable to the model.
distilled_invariants.validation: Projection lesion/size sweep measures required-state retention and decisions; missing projected state is reported as projection loss, never interpreted as absence in source state.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Entity session rows stored as ordinary messages contaminated recent/FTS retrieval; database repair plus query filters were required.
distilled_invariants.validation: Typed source/role/session class is mandatory on admission; retrieval policies filter by class; migration test repairs legacy rows and proves cross-session contamination absent.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Streaming bypassed central chat handler, so idle cognition kept GPU ownership until notify_chat_start was added directly to that ingress.
distilled_invariants.validation: Enumerate all chat/voice/API/bridge ingress paths; under injected idle workload every user ingress preempts/yields shared inference resources within frozen bound.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Ollama removal plus arbitration signal was reverted, then portions reappeared with safeguards; source history was not monotonic.
distilled_invariants.validation: Capability graph snapshot per release; upgrade/downgrade/revert replay proves dependencies, services, migrations and rollback correspond exactly to target version with no zombie capability.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Installer hung invisibly because interactive needrestart plus suppressed apt output produced no observable progress.
distilled_invariants.validation: Every long install/update/training phase emits start/heartbeat/deadline/terminal receipt; blocked interactive dependency becomes explicit blocker, never silent wait.

negative_results.result: Top-level optional torch import caused recurrent idle-thought crash when dependency absent.
Full primary grounded/system context overflowed 4096-token fallback and returned HTTP 400.
Unbounded/stale reflection queue plus repetitive prompt distribution reinforced stagnation.
Existing body/spatial state was behaviorally invisible solely because projection was overcompressed.
Misclassified system/entity-session memory contaminated user chat retrieval and required historical DB repair.
Backend model substitution altered identity/persona adherence enough to force routing change.
A revert simultaneously resurrected a removed dependency and removed a user-priority signal, proving nonmonotonic history.
